data.one_liner: Widget wrapper that lets a child float, drag and resize on screen.
data.what_it_does: It provides a FloatingOverlay widget that can be positioned anywhere on the screen and resized by the user. The overlay can be shown or hidden via a controller and supports optional constraints and padding.
use_when: You need a movable, resizable floating widget on top of your UI
You want to keep the overlay state across route pushes and pops
You need a simple, declarative API without external dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex gesture handling beyond drag and resize
You need a persistent overlay that survives app restarts or backgrounding
strengths: Easy to integrate with a simple controller API
Supports both absolute and relative sizing
Handles route changes automatically via RouteObserver
Provides stream of overlay data for reactive UI
weaknesses: Only works on Flutter, no native platform APIs
No built‑in persistence or advanced animation options
